## Experiments

1. **Memory on vs off** — recall 100% vs 0%. Memory is what carries facts across sessions.
2. **Short vs detailed system prompt** — 71 vs 495 tokens/request (7.0x cost); detailed prompts cost more on every turn.
3. **Different models** — latency gpt-4o-mini: 6.3 ms, gemini-1.5-flash: 6.9 ms. Mock backend, so identical; the model field is switchable per workspace for live comparison.
4. **Small vs large context (top-k)** — hit rate k=1: 100%, k=3: 100%, k=5: 100%. Larger k adds recall but also more prompt tokens.
5. **Conversation length** — latency at 0/~20/~60 messages: 7.0/6.0/6.4 ms. Roughly flat because only the last 10 messages are sent.
6. **Chunk size** (padded docs) — 30 words: hit 100%, mean top score 0.35, 75 chunks, 8.9 ms; 120 words: hit 100%, mean top score 0.14, 20 chunks, 2.8 ms; 400 words: hit 90%, mean top score 0.09, 10 chunks, 1.6 ms. Bigger chunks dilute similarity scores; smaller chunks give sharper citations.
